_comment: Allowed link-level dependencies between BESS static libraries (M1, roadmap section 14). `allowed` is the target DAG. Every `exceptions` entry is a grandfathered edge that violates it and must name an owner milestone and a removal phase; tools/check_link_graph.py fails on any edge in neither list and warns about exceptions that no longer occur.
